notes: Customer pricing (ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE + ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE_DET): legacy customer rights filter, customer required, lines (item, unit, sales price of the item, discount percent / value pair, quantity ranges may not intersect), buttons load items of the group / item ranges and copy the lines to another customer (APP_RULES3_SA). Wave 3b: legacy group / item / unit lists (item ranges within the group range, items of the line's group, units of the item: cascading), customer and item names.

rules.where: (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 OR :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER IN (SELECT T.PASSWORD_NUMBER FROM AR_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD T WHERE CUST_CODE BETWEEN T.FROM_CUSTOMER_CODE AND T.TO_CUSTOMER_CODE))

row_rules.ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE_DET:
-- legacy line WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM: item group, unit (basic by default), sales price of the item, discount percent <-> value,

app_rules3_sa.cgp_det_row(inserting, :new.cust_code, :new.item_group_code, :new.item_code, :new.unit_code, :new.unit_price,

validations.name: العميل
validations.plsql: declare l number; begin if :PAGE_CUST_CODE is null then return case when v('G_LANG') = 'en' then 'Enter the customer' else 'لا بد من ادخال رقم عميل' end; end if; select count(1) into l from customer where code = app_rules3_pr.to_n(:PAGE_CUST_CODE); if l = 0 then return app_rules3_pr.in_list('رقم العميل', 'customer'); end if; if :REQUEST = 'CREATE' then select count(1) into l from st_cust_group_price where cust_code = app_rules3_pr.to_n(:PAGE_CUST_CODE); if l > 0 then return case when v('G_LANG') = 'en' then 'The customer already has a pricing file' else 'رقم مكرر تم إدخالة من قبل' end; end if; end if; return null; end;

ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE.FROM_GROUP_CODE.lov: select item_group_code || ' - ' || name_a d, item_group_code r from st_item_group where nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or item_group_code in (select gp.group_code from st_group_password gp where gp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE.TO_GROUP_CODE.lov: select item_group_code || ' - ' || name_a d, item_group_code r from st_item_group where nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or item_group_code in (select gp.group_code from st_group_password gp where gp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE.FROM_ITEM_CODE.lov: select it.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(it.name_a, it.name_e) d, it.item_code r from st_item it where (:PAGE_FROM_GROUP_CODE is null or it.item_group_code >= :PAGE_FROM_GROUP_CODE) and (:PAGE_TO_GROUP_CODE is null or it.item_group_code <= :PAGE_TO_GROUP_CODE) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or it.item_group_code in (select gp.group_code from st_group_password gp where gp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE.TO_ITEM_CODE.lov: select it.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(it.name_a, it.name_e) d, it.item_code r from st_item it where (:PAGE_FROM_GROUP_CODE is null or it.item_group_code >= :PAGE_FROM_GROUP_CODE) and (:PAGE_TO_GROUP_CODE is null or it.item_group_code <= :PAGE_TO_GROUP_CODE) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or it.item_group_code in (select gp.group_code from st_group_password gp where gp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE_DET.ITEM_GROUP_CODE.lov: select item_group_code || ' - ' || name_a d, item_group_code r from st_item_group where nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or item_group_code in (select gp.group_code from st_group_password gp where gp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE_DET.ITEM_CODE.lov: select it.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(it.name_a, it.name_e) d, it.item_code r from st_item it where (:PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE is null or it.item_group_code = :PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or it.item_group_code in (select gp.group_code from st_group_password gp where gp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE_DET.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (iu.group_code = :PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE is null) and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE.CUST_NAME.sql: (select max(c.name_a) from customer c where c.code = t.cust_code)

ST_CUST_GROUP_PRICE_DET.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.item_group_code)
